caption: The drawing depicts a square textile divided into five rows and five columns, creating a grid of twenty-five squares. Each square alternates in color between a reddish-brown and an off-white or beige tone, forming a checkered pattern. The individual squares appear woven, with visible horizontal and vertical lines, and the edges of the textile are slightly wavy, creating an irregular outline rather than a precise rectangle. The textile is centered on a plain, light tan or cream background, with no other objects or decorations present. The drawing uses simple, flat shading with no indication of light or shadow, keeping the focus on the texture and color pattern of the textile.
title: Shaker Linen
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
